title: Laptop replacement
text: For a customer laptop that will not start, verify the customer identity and device warranty before arranging a replacement. If a replacement is needed the next day, escalate to the equipment team for availability. Do not promise delivery until availability is confirmed.

title: Account access
text: For portal access problems, verify the affected account and the user's identity before resetting access. Escalate if the account cannot be identified.

title: Invoice corrections
text: For an incorrect invoice, gather the invoice number and disputed line items before referring the case to billing.
